items.title: Awesome Claude Code
items.content_text: ### Documentation, Knowledge & Learning * [learn-faster-kit (⭐382)](https://github.com/hluaguo/learn-faster-kit) by [Hugo Lau](https://github.com/hluaguo) - A creative educational framework for Claude Code, inspired by the "FASTER" approach to self-teaching. Ships with a variety of agents, slash commands, and tools that enable Claude Code to help you progress at your own pace, employing well-established pedagogical techniques like active learning and spaced repetition.\        ### Documentation, Knowledge & Learning / Obsidian * [vir (⭐16)](https://github.com/djolex999/vir) by [Djordje Marković](https://github.com/djolex999) - Distills the Claude Code transcripts already on your disk into typed markdown notes (decisions, gotchas, patterns). Serves them via MCP and a CLAUDE.md block. Integrates with Obsidian.\        ### Research & Scientific Inquiry / Obsidian * [Claude Scientific Skills (⭐48k)](https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills) by [K-Dense](https://github.com/K-Dense-AI) - "A set of ready-to-use Agent Skills for research, science, engineering, analysis, finance and writing." That's their description - modest, simple. That's how you can tell this is really one of the best skills repos on GitHub. If you've ever thought about getting a PhD... just read all of these documents instead. Also I think it IS an AI agent or something? Awesome.\        ### Providers, Runtime & Integration Infrastructure / Obsidian * [SPARDA (⭐8)](https://github.com/zakariagharzouli/sparda) by [Zakaria Gharzouli (Residual Labs)](https://github.com/zakariagharzouli) - Converts a running Express or FastAPI app into an MCP server by AST-parsing its routes and injecting a marked, byte-for-byte-removable `/mcp` router, so the agent can operate your live application (real auth, real data) rather than just read files. Exceptionally safety-minded: writes are disabled by default behind two-phase confirmation, docstrings are sanitized against prompt injection, a circuit-breaker quarantines failing routes, nothing leaves the machine, and persistence stores structure never payloads.\        ### Remote Control, Notifications & Voice I/O / Obsidian * [anotifier (⭐27)](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions/anotifier-for-claude-codex-cursor) by [Amin Dhouib (Devino Solutions)](https://github.com/DevinoSolutions) - A zero-dependency, cross-platform notifier that fires a desktop toast and a free phone push (via ntfy) the moment Claude Code (or Codex/Cursor/Gemini) finishes a task or needs input, wired up by a one-command setup. The standout among notifiers is its testing rigor — CI drives the *real* agent CLIs end to end and asserts real ntfy round-trips and real OS toast delivery, no mocks.\        * [Claude CLI ↔ Telegram (⭐36)](https://github.com/Imolatte/claude-cli-telegram) by [Imolatte](https://github.com/Imolatte) - A feature-rich Telegram bot that turns your machine into a remote Claude Code terminal driven from your phone: streaming tool progress, voice input, a git panel, Mac remote control, and 30+ commands. Its standout is the approval flow — dangerous-op Approve/Deny taps are injected straight into the real terminal prompt via `tmux send-keys`, so you authorize from your phone without killing the session or losing context.\        ### Alternative Clients / Obsidian * [Agent Workbench](https://github.com/cvelasquez/agent-workbench) by [cvelasquez](https://github.com/cvelasquez) - Local web UI that runs the unmodified Claude Code CLI in a pseudo-terminal and adds tabs, a browsable history of past sessions, conversations rendered as cards, a context meter, and the agent's multiple-choice questions answered from the UI.\        ### Writing & Prose Quality / Obsidian * [oh-my-patent (⭐103)](https://github.com/illusionaireal/oh-my-patent) by [illusionaireal](https://github.com/illusionaireal) - A plugin for turning technical ideas into patent disclosures.\        * [Scientific Writing Skills (⭐3)](https://github.com/dvdsosa/scientific-writing-skills) by [David Sosa-Trejo](https://github.com/dvdsosa) - Six Agent Skills for scientific writing based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences course: sentence-level prose editing, IMRaD manuscript structure, the writing process, peer review and publication, grants and recommendation letters, and lay summaries and press. Ships as the sciwrite Claude Code plugin with four stdlib-only Python audit scripts.\        ### Infrastructure & DevOps / Obsidian * [pwa2play (⭐1)](https://github.com/degordonstech/pwa2play) by [degordonstech](https://github.com/degordonstech) - Packages a PWA into a signed Play Store Android bundle with Bubblewrap and checks target API level, signing key reuse, assetlinks fingerprints and version codes before upload.\        ### Agent Orchestration / Ralph Wiggum * [ralph-harness (⭐3)](https://github.com/vkuprin/ralph-harness) by [Vitaly Kuprin](https://github.com/vkuprin) - A CLI that runs Claude Code in a loop, with a fresh `claude -p` process for each iteration in a harness-owned git worktree.\        ### Skills / Dynamic Workflows * [Cooklang skills (⭐9)](https://github.com/cooklang/cooklang-skills) by [dubadub](https://github.com/dubadub) - Skills and an MCP server that let AI agents work with [Cooklang](https://cooklang.org/) recipes: plain-text .cook recipes and .menu meal plans in a folder you own.\        * [localpr (⭐4)](https://github.com/gilles-g/localpr) by [gilles-g](https://github.com/gilles-g) - Reviews Claude's uncommitted changes in a local GitHub-style pull request page: comment on any line, send comments in batches while Claude keeps working, ask Claude questions answered inline in the thread, and get each comment back marked fixed or refused.\        ### Lists & Collections / Observability * [Awesome Claude Code Mods (⭐303)](https://github.com/karanb192/awesome-claude-code-mods) by [Karan Bansal](https://github.com/karanb192) - A community list of Claude Code mods built with function hooks. Scans public GitHub repositories and shows what the validator reports each mod can read, write, run or send over the network.\

items.content_text:
### Open source / GPL (with linking exception)

*   [gnat-patches (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/gnat-patches) - Curated GCC/GNAT patchsets against checksum-pinned upstream sources, each backed by an executable regression, published as patched native toolchain builds for GCC 13 through 16.

### Runtimes / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology) - Experimental GNAT runtime extension for ordinary Ada tasking, adding task-aware I/O and an opt-in lightweight lane that runs designated tasks as fibers on shared event loops.

### Distributed / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [ipfs (⭐0)](https://github.com/kokhlo/ipfs) - InterPlanetary File System client library: CID/multihash/multibase, CAR archives with block verification, trustless HTTP gateway client.

### Terminal User Interface / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-tui (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-tui) - Typed, declarative terminal user-interface toolkit for Ada.

### Database / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-postgres (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-postgres) - Client and server primitives for the PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol, built on [flyology (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology) task-aware I/O.

### Web / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-http (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-http) - HTTP/1.1 clients and servers with opt-in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 engines and WebSocket support, built on [flyology (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology) task-aware I/O.

### Algorithms, Containers and Protocols / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-allocators (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_allocators) - Caller-owned buddy, best-fit, TLSF, and slab/span allocation algorithms with no hosted operating system dependency.
*   [flyology-cachelines (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_cachelines) - Cache-line-aware storage, ownership-aware groups, grouped arrays, and host cache queries.

### Format Readers, Writers and Checkers / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-iri (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-http/tree/main/flyology_iri) - Allocation-conscious URI, IRI, and WHATWG URL parsing.
*   [flyology-rdf (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-rdf) - RDF 1.2 terms, streaming Turtle, TriG, N-Triples and N-Quads parsing, RDFC-1.0 dataset canonicalization, Notation3, and SPARQL 1.1 query syntax.

### Networking and Communication Middleware / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-quic (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-http/tree/main/flyology_quic) - Experimental bounded QUIC transport with protocol state, streams, loss recovery, and congestion control.

### General Purpose Computing / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-simd (⭐0)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology-simd) - Portable, strongly typed SIMD foundations for Ada.

### Utilities / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-bench (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_bench) - Adaptive microbenchmarking with balanced comparisons, diagnostics, baselines, and machine-readable reports.
*   [flyology-debug (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_debug) - Bounded in-memory tracing, producer shards, retained batches, and persistent gauges.

### Linux and POSIX / GPL (no linking exception)

*   [flyology-numa (⭐9)](https://github.com/flyology-ada/flyology/tree/main/flyology_numa) - Memory-node topology reporting, memory placement on a chosen node, and node-bound storage pools.

items.title: Awesome Chrome Devtools
items.content_text:
### Tracing & Profiling

*   [trace.cafe](https://trace.cafe/) - Share and view web performance traces directly in the DevTools Performance panel ([source (⭐142)](https://github.com/paulirish/trace.cafe)).
*   [speedscope (⭐6.8k)](https://github.com/jlfwong/speedscope) - Fast, interactive flamegraph viewer that imports Chrome `.cpuprofile` and timeline traces.
*   [cpupro (⭐788)](https://github.com/discoveryjs/cpupro) - Deep V8/Chrome `.cpuprofile` analyzer with flamegraphs, call trees, and hot-spot diagnostics.
*   [Perfetto (⭐6.6k)](https://github.com/google/perfetto) - System profiling and trace analysis suite ([ui.perfetto.dev](https://ui.perfetto.dev/)) with Chromium trace support and SQL trace querying.

### Chrome DevTools Protocol / The big two automation libraries

*   [Puppeteer (⭐96k)](https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer) - High-level Node.js API for controlling Chrome over CDP and WebDriver BiDi. See also [awesome-puppeteer (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/transitive-bullshit/awesome-puppeteer).

### Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above)

*   Rust: [chromiumoxide (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/mattsse/chromiumoxide) - Async/tokio library with generated types
*   Rust: [Rust Headless Chrome (⭐3k)](https://github.com/rust-headless-chrome/rust-headless-chrome) - High-level headless Chrome client
*   Python: [Zendriver (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/cdpdriver/zendriver) - Async CDP browser automation
*   Ruby: [Ferrum (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/rubycdp/ferrum) - High-level API to control Chrome
*   Ruby: [Cuprite (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/rubycdp/cuprite) - Capybara driver
*   Kotlin: [kdriver (⭐108)](https://github.com/cdpdriver/kdriver) - High-level coroutine-based automation

### Chrome DevTools Protocol / Agentic Browser Automation

*   [chrome-devtools-mcp (⭐53k)](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp) - Official MCP server for Chrome DevTools, which also includes a [CLI (⭐53k)](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/blob/main/skills/chrome-devtools-cli/SKILL.md).
*   [Webcmd (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/agentrhq/webcmd) - Compiles site navigation into deterministic per-site CLI commands for AI agents.
*   [bdg (⭐152)](https://github.com/szymdzum/browser-debugger-cli) - Persistent background CDP session exposing DOM, network, console, and raw protocol methods as shell commands.

### Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters

*   [ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend (⭐4.1k)](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend) - Canonical source repo for the Chrome DevTools UI (published to npm as [chrome-devtools-frontend](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chrome-devtools-frontend)).
*   [Chii (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/liriliri/chii) & [Eruda (⭐21k)](https://github.com/liriliri/eruda) - Remote debugging server using the real `devtools-frontend` UI (`Chii`, a modern Weinre replacement) and in-page mobile DevTools console (`Eruda`).
*   [vscode-js-debug (⭐2k)](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-js-debug) - Official DAP-compliant JavaScript and Chrome CDP debugger powering VS Code.

### DevTools Extensions / Browser Adapters

*   [Vue.js Developer Tools (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/vuejs/devtools) - Inspect Vue.js components, state, and routing.

### Alumni / Browser Adapters

*   [noice-json-rpc (⭐46)](https://github.com/nojvek/noice-json-rpc) - Proxy-based TypeScript/JS library exposing CDP domains directly as an API.

### Mobile

*   [Evergreen-Compose (⭐2)](https://github.com/atgreen/evergreen-compose) - Build native Android apps in Evergreen Common Lisp, using Jetpack Compose and Material 3. GPL-3.0-or-later WITH Classpath-exception-2.0.
    *   Evergreen Compose supplies a shared, precompiled Android runtime. Application builds require EGCL and egcl-target-android (runtime API 4), no JDK, Kotlin compiler, Gradle, Android SDK or NDK.
    *   Develop inside the running app. Connect Emacs with SLY or icl to the phone's Lisp image through an ADB-forwarded Slynk port. Evaluate Lisp, inspect application state, and update the running UI without rebuilding or reinstalling the APK

### Work in progress

*   [LCL - Lua Common Lisp](https://codeberg.org/gsou/LCL) -  Lua Common Lisp is an implementation of Common Lisp targeting the Lua language. The goal of this project is to provide an implementation of Common Lisp that can be used wherever an unmodified Lua VM is running.
*   (LLM) [Evergreen (⭐21)](https://github.com/atgreen/evergreen): Evergreen is Common Lisp with a HotSpot-inspired native runtime, built from scratch in Rust. It starts executing in bytecode, compiles hot code to native instructions, and specializes dynamically typed programs as they run.
    *   new as of Oct, 2026
    *   *warning: this is an experiment. The parts that do work may not behave the way you expect, or the way the standard says they should. It may never work.*
    *   Lightweight fibers with synchronous socket I/O
    *   Native interoperability (C, JVM, Python)
    *   Standalone applications and saved images.
    *   The default x86-64 Linux build is fully static
    *   Tree shaking of Lisp and Rust
    *   Native Android applications with Slime-style development: see [evergreen-compose (⭐2)](https://github.com/atgreen/evergreen-compose)
    *   *Core code, test suites, and documentation were almost entirely generated by AI assistants following high-level human prompts and specification. Conceptual architecture, prompt direction, and repository orchestration (minimal manual code review or line-by-line verification).*

### JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

*   [Apache ECharts (⭐67k)](https://github.com/apache/echarts) - Highly customizable and interactive charts ready for big datasets.
*   [billboard.js (⭐6k)](https://github.com/naver/billboard.js) - Reusable D3.js-based chart library with SVG and Canvas rendering, maintained by NAVER.
*   [C3.js (⭐9.3k)](https://github.com/c3js/c3) - D3-based reusable chart library.
*   [Cal-Heatmap (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/wa0x6e/cal-heatmap) - Time-series calendar heatmaps, similar to GitHub's contribution graph, built on D3.
*   [Carbon Charts (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-charts) - Chart library from IBM's Carbon Design System, built on D3, with React, Angular, Vue and Svelte wrappers.
*   [chart.xkcd (⭐7.9k)](https://github.com/timqian/chart.xkcd) - Chart library that renders line, bar, pie and other charts in a hand-drawn xkcd style.
*   [ChartGPU (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/ChartGPU/ChartGPU) - WebGPU charting library for large datasets, real-time streaming and multi-chart dashboards.
*   [Charts.css (⭐6.6k)](https://github.com/ChartsCSS/charts.css) - CSS framework that styles HTML tables as charts.
*   [DHTMLX Gantt (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/DHTMLX/gantt) - Gantt chart component for project schedules, with task dependencies and drag-and-drop editing.
*   [ECharts GL (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/ecomfe/echarts-gl) - Extension for Apache ECharts that adds 3D plots, globe visualizations and WebGL-accelerated series.
*   [Flot (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/flot/flot) - jQuery plotting library for line, bar and pie charts with zooming and other interactive features.
*   [Frappe Charts (⭐15k)](https://github.com/frappe/charts) - Simple, responsive SVG charts with zero dependencies.
*   [Frappe Gantt (⭐6.1k)](https://github.com/frappe/gantt) - Simple, interactive SVG Gantt chart library.
*   [G2 (⭐13k)](https://github.com/antvis/G2) - An interactive and responsive charting library based on the grammar of graphics, maintained by Alibaba.
*   [heatmap.js (⭐6.4k)](https://github.com/pa7/heatmap.js) - Canvas-based library for rendering heatmaps, with plugins for Leaflet and Google Maps.
*   [roughViz (⭐7.2k)](https://github.com/jwilber/roughViz) - Sketchy, hand-drawn style charts for the browser, based on Rough.js.
*   [TOAST UI Chart (⭐5.4k)](https://github.com/nhn/tui.chart) - Complete library with support for legacy browsers.
*   [Unovis (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/f5/unovis) - Modular data visualization framework for React, Angular, Svelte, Vue and vanilla TypeScript, by F5.
*   [uPlot (⭐11k)](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) - Small, fast canvas-based charts for time series, lines, areas, OHLC and bars.
*   [VChart (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/VisActor/VChart) - Cross-platform charting library with animation and storytelling features, from ByteDance's VisActor.

### JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

*   [3d-force-graph (⭐6.4k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph) - 3D force-directed graph component using Three.js/WebGL.
*   [cosmos.gl (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/cosmosgl/graph) - GPU-accelerated force graph layout and rendering engine that runs entirely in WebGL shaders.
*   [dagre (⭐5.8k)](https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre) - Directed graph layout library for JavaScript.
*   [elkjs (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs) - Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) graph layout algorithms for JavaScript.
*   [force-graph (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph) - Force-directed graph component rendered on HTML5 canvas.
*   [JointJS (⭐5.4k)](https://github.com/clientIO/joint) - SVG-based JavaScript diagramming library for interactive diagrams and graph editors.
*   [Viz.js (⭐4.3k)](https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js) - Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly for rendering DOT graphs in the browser and Node.js.
*   [Vue Flow (⭐6.9k)](https://github.com/bcakmakoglu/vue-flow) - Flowchart and node-based graph component for Vue 3.
*   [X6 (⭐6.7k)](https://github.com/antvis/X6) - Diagramming library for DAGs, ER diagrams, flowcharts and other graph editors, maintained by Alibaba.
*   [xyflow (⭐39k)](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow) - React Flow and Svelte Flow: libraries for building node-based editors, flow charts and interactive diagrams.

### JavaScript tools / Financial charts

*   [chartjs-chart-financial (⭐809)](https://github.com/chartjs/chartjs-chart-financial) - Chart.js module that adds candlestick and OHLC chart types.
*   [HQChart (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/jones2000/HQChart) - K-line and stock charts with a technical indicator scripting engine, for web pages and WeChat mini programs.
*   [KLineChart (⭐4.2k)](https://github.com/klinecharts/KLineChart) - Lightweight, highly customizable candlestick (k-line) chart with zero dependencies and mobile support.
*   [Lightweight Charts (⭐17k)](https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts) - Performant HTML5 canvas financial charts, from TradingView.
*   [React Financial Charts (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/react-financial/react-financial-charts) - React components for financial charts: candlesticks, technical indicators, overlays and drawing tools.
*   [TradeCanvas (⭐22)](https://github.com/bonguynvan/tradecanvas) - Financial charts with indicators, drawing tools and live feeds, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL.
*   [Vela (⭐992)](https://github.com/LuxAlgo/Vela) - Financial charting library with a headless core, native WebGL2 renderer and plugin SDK, from LuxAlgo.

### JavaScript tools / Maps

*   [Cesium (⭐16k)](https://github.com/CesiumGS/cesium) - WebGL 3D globes and maps.
*   [COBE (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/shuding/cobe) - Lightweight WebGL globe library of about 5 kB, with configurable markers.
*   [globe.gl (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl) - UI component for globe data visualization using Three.js/WebGL.
*   [mapcn (⭐12k)](https://github.com/AnmolSaini16/mapcn) - Map components for React built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind and compatible with shadcn/ui.
*   [MapLibre GL JS (⭐12k)](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js) - WebGL-based interactive vector tile maps in the browser; community fork of Mapbox GL JS.
*   [maptalks.js (⭐4.5k)](https://github.com/maptalks/maptalks.js) - Pluggable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
*   [OpenLayers (⭐13k)](https://github.com/openlayers/openlayers) - Library for interactive web maps with support for many data sources, formats and projections.
*   [Potree (⭐5.6k)](https://github.com/potree/potree) - WebGL point cloud viewer for large datasets such as LiDAR scans.
*   [React Simple Maps (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/zcreativelabs/react-simple-maps) - Composable SVG map charts for React, based on d3-geo and TopoJSON.
*   [react-map-gl (⭐8.5k)](https://github.com/visgl/react-map-gl) - React components for MapLibre GL JS and Mapbox GL JS, maintained by vis.gl.
*   [TerriaJS (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/TerriaJS/terriajs) - Library for building web-based 2D and 3D geospatial data explorers with catalogs of map layers.

### JavaScript tools / d3

*   [D3.js (⭐114k)](https://github.com/d3/d3) - JavaScript library for producing dynamic, data-driven visualizations with SVG, Canvas and HTML.

### JavaScript tools / React

*   [Ant Design Charts (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design-charts) - React chart library based on AntV, with statistical charts, graphs and maps.
*   [echarts-for-react (⭐5k)](https://github.com/hustcc/echarts-for-react) - React wrapper for Apache ECharts.
*   [MUI X Charts (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/mui/mui-x/tree/master/packages/x-charts) - React chart components from MUI; the community package is MIT-licensed.
*   [react-chartjs-2 (⭐6.9k)](https://github.com/reactchartjs/react-chartjs-2) - React components for Chart.js.
*   [react-force-graph (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/vasturiano/react-force-graph) - React components for 2D, 3D, VR and AR force-directed graphs.
*   [react-plotly.js (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/plotly/react-plotly.js) - React component for Plotly.js charts, maintained by Plotly.
*   [Semiotic (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic) - React data visualization library for charts, network graphs and streaming data.
*   [Tremor (⭐16k)](https://github.com/tremorlabs/tremor-npm) - React components for building charts and dashboards, based on Recharts and Tailwind CSS.
*   [visx (⭐21k)](https://github.com/airbnb/visx) - Low-level visualization components that combine D3 with React, by Airbnb.

### JavaScript tools / React Native

*   [React Native Chart Kit (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/chart-kit/react-native-chart-kit) - Line, bar, pie, progress and contribution graph charts for React Native.
*   [react-native-charts-wrapper (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/wuxudong/react-native-charts-wrapper) - React Native wrapper for MPAndroidChart and DGCharts on Android and iOS.
*   [react-native-gifted-charts (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/Abhinandan-Kushwaha/react-native-gifted-charts) - Bar, line, area, pie, radar, bubble and candlestick charts for React Native, with animations.
*   [react-native-graph (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-graph) - Animated, high-performance line graphs for React Native, built with Skia.
*   [react-native-maps (⭐16k)](https://github.com/react-native-maps/react-native-maps) - Map view component for iOS and Android in React Native.
*   [Victory Native (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/victory-native-xl) - High-performance charting library for React Native, built on React Native Skia.

### JavaScript tools / Misc

*   [asciichart (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/kroitor/asciichart) - ASCII line charts for the console in Node.js and browsers, with ports to other languages.
*   [blessed-contrib (⭐16k)](https://github.com/yaronn/blessed-contrib) - Terminal dashboards with charts, maps, gauges and tables, built with Node.js and ASCII/ANSI art.
*   [Flint (⭐4.3k)](https://github.com/microsoft/flint-chart) - Chart specification language from Microsoft that compiles to Vega-Lite, ECharts, Chart.js or Plotly.
*   [Layer Cake (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/mhkeller/layercake) - Graphics framework for building reusable charts with Svelte.
*   [LayerChart (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/techniq/layerchart) - Composable Svelte chart components for cartesian, radial, hierarchical, graph and geo charts.
*   [Mosaic (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/uwdata/mosaic) - Framework for linking databases such as DuckDB with interactive views to visualize large datasets.
*   [ng2-charts (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/valor-software/ng2-charts) - Angular directives for Chart.js charts.
*   [ngx-charts (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/swimlane/ngx-charts) - Declarative charting framework for Angular, using D3 for math and Angular for rendering.
*   [Perspective (⭐11k)](https://github.com/perspective-dev/perspective) - Interactive analytics and visualization component for large and streaming datasets, built on WebAssembly.
*   [vis-timeline (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/visjs/vis-timeline) - Interactive timelines and 2D graphs with items and ranges, from the vis.js project.
*   [vtk.js (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/Kitware/vtk-js) - JavaScript implementation of the Visualization Toolkit (VTK) for scientific visualization on the web.
*   [Vue Data UI (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/graphieros/vue-data-ui) - Vue 3 component library of charts, gauges, tables and other data visualizations.
*   [vue-chartjs (⭐5.7k)](https://github.com/apertureless/vue-chartjs) - Vue.js wrapper for Chart.js.
*   [vue-echarts (⭐11k)](https://github.com/ecomfe/vue-echarts) - Vue.js component for Apache ECharts.

### Android tools / Misc

*   [HelloCharts (⭐7.6k)](https://github.com/lecho/hellocharts-android) - Android chart library with line, column, pie, bubble and combo charts, plus zoom and scroll.
*   [Vico (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/patrykandpatrick/vico) - Extensible chart library for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform.

### C++ tools / Misc

*   [F3D (⭐4.7k)](https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d) - Cross-platform, fast, and minimalist 3D viewer with scientific visualization tools.
*   [ImPlot (⭐6.2k)](https://github.com/epezent/implot) - Immediate-mode plotting library for Dear ImGui.
*   [ImPlot3D (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/brenocq/implot3d) - Immediate-mode 3D plotting extension for Dear ImGui, inspired by ImPlot.
*   [MapLibre Native (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-native) - Interactive vector tile map rendering for iOS, Android and other native platforms.
*   [Mapnik (⭐4k)](https://github.com/mapnik/mapnik) - Toolkit for rendering maps, widely used to render OpenStreetMap tiles.
*   [Matplot++ (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/alandefreitas/matplotplusplus) - C++ graphics library for data visualization with a MATLAB-like API.
*   [OpenSpace (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/OpenSpace/OpenSpace) - Interactive software for visualizing the known universe, from astronomy catalogs to space missions.
*   [ParaView (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/Kitware/ParaView) - Multi-platform data analysis and visualization application based on VTK.
*   [PlotJuggler (⭐6.2k)](https://github.com/PlotJuggler/PlotJuggler) - open-source Qt5 application to plot charts (based on Qwt).
*   [Polyscope (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/nmwsharp/polyscope) - Viewer and user interface for 3D geometry processing.
*   [QCustomPlot](https://www.qcustomplot.com/) - Qt C++ widget for plotting and data visualization.
*   [ROOT (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/root-project/root) - CERN framework for analyzing, storing and visualizing large scientific datasets.
*   [Serial Studio (⭐7.2k)](https://github.com/Serial-Studio/Serial-Studio) - Real-time telemetry dashboard for data from serial ports, Bluetooth LE, network sockets and other sources.
*   [TTK (⭐481)](https://github.com/topology-tool-kit/ttk) - Topological data analysis and visualization.
*   [VisIt (⭐532)](https://github.com/visit-dav/visit) - Visualization and analysis tool for large mesh-based scientific data, developed at LLNL.
*   [Visualization Toolkit (VTK) (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/Kitware/VTK) - open-source library for 3d Graphics, image processing and visualization.

### Dashboards and BI / Misc

*   [Apache Superset (⭐75k)](https://github.com/apache/superset) - Data exploration and visualization platform with a no-code chart builder, SQL IDE and dashboards.
*   [DataLens (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/datalens-tech/datalens) - Business intelligence and data visualization system, originally developed at Yandex.
*   [datart (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/running-elephant/datart) - Data visualization platform for building reports, dashboards and data stories.
*   [Evidence (⭐7k)](https://github.com/evidence-dev/evidence) - Business intelligence as code: build reports and dashboards with SQL and Markdown.
*   [Grafana (⭐77k)](https://github.com/grafana/grafana) - Observability and data visualization platform for metrics, logs and traces from many data sources.
*   [Kibana (⭐21k)](https://github.com/elastic/kibana) - Visualization and dashboard UI for data stored in Elasticsearch.
*   [Lightdash (⭐6.2k)](https://github.com/lightdash/lightdash) - BI tool that turns dbt projects into metrics, charts and dashboards.
*   [Metabase (⭐50k)](https://github.com/metabase/metabase) - Business intelligence tool for querying data and building dashboards, with embedded analytics.
*   [Observable Framework (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/observablehq/framework) - Static site generator for data apps, dashboards and reports using JavaScript, SQL and Markdown.
*   [OpenSearch Dashboards (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch-Dashboards) - Visualization and dashboard UI for OpenSearch; Apache-2.0 fork of Kibana 7.10.
*   [Perses (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/perses/perses) - CNCF dashboard tool and open dashboard specification for observability data such as Prometheus metrics.
*   [Redash (⭐29k)](https://github.com/getredash/redash) - Query data sources with SQL, then visualize the results and build dashboards.
*   [Rill (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/rilldata/rill) - BI tool for fast, metrics-first dashboards powered by OLAP engines such as DuckDB and ClickHouse.

### Flutter tools / Misc

*   [fl\_chart (⭐7.6k)](https://github.com/imaNNeo/fl_chart) - Customizable Flutter chart library with line, bar, pie, scatter and radar charts.
*   [flutter\_map (⭐3k)](https://github.com/fleaflet/flutter_map) - Vendor-free, customizable interactive map package for Flutter.
*   [Graphic (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/entronad/graphic) - Grammar of graphics data visualization and charting library for Flutter.

### Golang tools / Misc

*   [asciigraph (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/guptarohit/asciigraph) - Lightweight ASCII line graphs for command-line apps.
*   [go-diagrams (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/blushft/go-diagrams) - Diagram-as-code library for system architecture diagrams in Go, rendered with Graphviz.
*   [go-echarts (⭐7.6k)](https://github.com/go-echarts/go-echarts) - Simple yet powerful data visualizing library for Go.
*   [termdash (⭐3k)](https://github.com/mum4k/termdash) - Terminal-based dashboard library with line charts, bar charts, gauges and donuts.
*   [termui (⭐14k)](https://github.com/gizak/termui) - Terminal dashboard and widget library with charts, gauges, sparklines and more.

### iOS tools / Misc

*   [Charts (⭐28k)](https://github.com/ChartsOrg/Charts) -  iOS port of MPAndroidChart. You can create charts for both platforms with very similar code.
*   [ChartView (⭐5.6k)](https://github.com/AppPear/ChartView) - Line, bar and pie chart views built with SwiftUI.
*   [Core Plot (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/core-plot/core-plot) - 2D plotting framework for macOS, iOS and tvOS.
*   [SwiftCharts (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/ivnsch/SwiftCharts) - Customizable charts library for iOS.

### Julia tools / Misc

*   [AlgebraOfGraphics.jl (⭐519)](https://github.com/MakieOrg/AlgebraOfGraphics.jl) - Algebraic grammar-of-graphics visualization for Julia, built on Makie.
*   [Gadfly.jl (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/GiovineItalia/Gadfly.jl) - Statistical graphics for Julia based on the grammar of graphics.
*   [Makie (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/MakieOrg/Makie.jl) - Interactive, high-performance plotting ecosystem for Julia with OpenGL, WebGL and Cairo backends.
*   [Plots.jl (⭐2k)](https://github.com/JuliaPlots/Plots.jl) - Plotting meta-package for Julia with a single API over multiple backends.
*   [UnicodePlots.jl (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/JuliaPlots/UnicodePlots.jl) - Unicode-based scientific plotting in the terminal for Julia.

### JVM tools / Misc

*   [JFreeChart (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/jfree/jfreechart) - 2D chart library for Java applications using Swing, JavaFX or server-side rendering.
*   [Kandy (⭐746)](https://github.com/Kotlin/kandy) - Kotlin plotting library with a typed DSL, developed by JetBrains.
*   [Lets-Plot for Kotlin (⭐487)](https://github.com/JetBrains/lets-plot-kotlin) - Grammar of graphics plotting API for Kotlin, built on Lets-Plot.
*   [XChart (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/knowm/XChart) - Lightweight Java library for plotting data.

### Machine Learning tools / Misc

*   [Aim (⭐6.3k)](https://github.com/aimhubio/aim) - Experiment tracker with a UI to explore and compare ML runs and metrics.
*   [BertViz (⭐8.2k)](https://github.com/jessevig/bertviz) - Visualize attention in Transformer language models such as BERT and GPT-2.
*   [dtreeviz (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/parrt/dtreeviz) - Decision tree visualization and model interpretation library for Python.
*   [Embedding Atlas (⭐5k)](https://github.com/apple/embedding-atlas) - Interactive visualization of large embeddings with search, filtering and density views, by Apple.
*   [FiftyOne (⭐11k)](https://github.com/voxel51/fiftyone) - Tool for visualizing, curating and evaluating computer vision datasets and models.
*   [LIT (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/PAIR-code/lit) - Learning Interpretability Tool: interactive visual analysis of ML model behavior, by Google PAIR.
*   [Model Explorer (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/model-explorer) - Hierarchical graph visualizer and debugger for ML models, from Google.
*   [Netron (⭐34k)](https://github.com/lutzroeder/netron) - Viewer for neural network, deep learning and machine learning models.
*   [NN-SVG (⭐5.7k)](https://github.com/alexlenail/NN-SVG) - Web tool for drawing publication-ready neural network architecture diagrams and exporting them to SVG.
*   [PlotNeuralNet (⭐25k)](https://github.com/HarisIqbal88/PlotNeuralNet) - LaTeX code for drawing neural network architecture diagrams.
*   [TensorBoard (⭐7.2k)](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorboard) - TensorFlow's visualization toolkit for metrics, model graphs, embeddings and more.
*   [Visdom (⭐10k)](https://github.com/fossasia/visdom) - Tool for real-time visualization and monitoring of live data such as ML experiments.
*   [VisualDL (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/VisualDL) - Deep learning visualization toolkit for metrics, graphs, embeddings and more, from PaddlePaddle.
*   [Yellowbrick (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/DistrictDataLabs/yellowbrick) - Visual analysis and diagnostic tools for machine learning model selection with scikit-learn.

### .NET tools / Misc

*   [LiveCharts2 (⭐5.5k)](https://github.com/Live-Charts/LiveCharts2) - Animated, interactive charts, maps and gauges for .NET UI frameworks.
*   [Mapsui (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/Mapsui/Mapsui) - .NET map component for MAUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, Blazor, WPF and WinUI.
*   [Microcharts (⭐2.1k)](https://github.com/microcharts-dotnet/Microcharts) - Simple cross-platform charts for .NET, drawn with SkiaSharp.
*   [MSAGL (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/microsoft/automatic-graph-layout) - Microsoft Automatic Graph Layout: tools for graph layout and viewing in .NET.
*   [OxyPlot (⭐3.5k)](https://github.com/oxyplot/oxyplot) - Cross-platform plotting library for .NET.
*   [Plotly.NET (⭐862)](https://github.com/plotly/Plotly.NET) - Interactive charts for F# and C#, based on Plotly.js.
*   [ScottPlot (⭐6.8k)](https://github.com/ScottPlot/ScottPlot) - Interactive plotting library for .NET with WinForms, WPF, Avalonia, Blazor and other controls.
*   [XCharts (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/XCharts-Team/XCharts) - Charting and data visualization library for Unity, built on UGUI.

### Python tools / Misc

*   [bokeh](https://bokeh.org/) - Interactive Web Plotting for Python.
*   [Cartopy (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/SciTools/cartopy) - Cartographic projections and geospatial data plotting with matplotlib.
*   [D-Tale (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/man-group/dtale) - Web-based visual explorer for pandas DataFrames with charts, summaries and correlations.
*   [Dash (⭐24k)](https://github.com/plotly/dash) - Framework for building data apps and dashboards in Python, built on Plotly.js and React.
*   [Datashader (⭐3.6k)](https://github.com/holoviz/datashader) - Renders very large datasets into accurate images by rasterizing them.
*   [fastplotlib (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/fastplotlib/fastplotlib) - GPU-accelerated plotting library built on WGPU and pygfx for fast interactive visualization.
*   [folium (⭐7.4k)](https://github.com/python-visualization/folium) - Builds interactive Leaflet.js maps from Python data.
*   [hvPlot (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/holoviz/hvplot) - High-level plotting API for pandas, xarray, Dask, NetworkX and other data structures, built on HoloViews.
*   [ipyleaflet (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/jupyter-widgets/ipyleaflet) - Interactive Leaflet maps in Jupyter notebooks, built on ipywidgets.
*   [leafmap (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/opengeos/leafmap) - Interactive mapping and geospatial analysis in Jupyter with multiple mapping backends.
*   [Lets-Plot (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/JetBrains/lets-plot) - Grammar of graphics plotting library for Python and Kotlin, by JetBrains.
*   [LIDA (⭐3.3k)](https://github.com/microsoft/lida) - Generates visualizations and infographics from data with large language models, from Microsoft.
*   [lightweight-charts-python (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/louisnw01/lightweight-charts-python) - Python interface to TradingView's Lightweight Charts for financial charts.

*   [WordCloud (⭐11k)](https://github.com/amueller/word_cloud) - Word cloud generator for Python.

### R tools / Misc

*   [circlize (⭐1k)](https://github.com/jokergoo/circlize) - Circular visualization in R, such as chord diagrams and Circos-style genomic plots.

*   [DiagrammeR (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/rich-iannone/DiagrammeR) - Graph and network diagrams in R, rendered with Graphviz and mermaid.
*   [esquisse (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/dreamRs/esquisse) - Drag-and-drop interface for building ggplot2 charts in RStudio or Shiny.
*   [gganimate (⭐2k)](https://github.com/thomasp85/gganimate) - Grammar of animated graphics that extends ggplot2.
*   [ggiraph (⭐880)](https://github.com/davidgohel/ggiraph) - Makes ggplot2 graphics interactive, with tooltips, hover effects and selections.
*   [ggpubr (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/kassambara/ggpubr) - ggplot2-based functions for publication-ready plots with statistical annotations.
*   [ggraph (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/thomasp85/ggraph) - Grammar of graphics for graphs and networks, extending ggplot2.
*   [ggrepel (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/slowkow/ggrepel) - Repels overlapping text labels away from each other in ggplot2 plots.
*   [ggstatsplot (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/ggstatsplot) - ggplot2-based plots with statistical test details included in the graphic.
*   [gt (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/rstudio/gt) - Builds publication-quality display tables in R.
*   [htmlwidgets (⭐801)](https://github.com/ramnathv/htmlwidgets) - Framework for binding JavaScript visualization libraries to R, for use in R Markdown and Shiny.
*   [Leaflet for R (⭐841)](https://github.com/rstudio/leaflet) - R interface to the Leaflet JavaScript library for interactive maps.
*   [patchwork (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/thomasp85/patchwork) - Composes multiple ggplot2 plots into a single figure.
*   [plotly (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.R) - Interactive charts (including adding interactivity to ggplot2 output), cartograms and simple network diagrams
*   [rayshader (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/tylermorganwall/rayshader) - 2D and 3D mapping and data visualization in R, including 3D renders of ggplot2 plots.
*   [tmap (⭐909)](https://github.com/r-tmap/tmap) - Thematic maps in R, with a ggplot2-like layered syntax and static or interactive output.

### Ruby tools / Misc

*   [Blazer (⭐4.8k)](https://github.com/ankane/blazer) - Business intelligence tool for Rails apps: explore data with SQL and build charts and dashboards.
*   [Gruff (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/topfunky/gruff) - Graphing library for Ruby that renders charts as images using RMagick.
*   [YouPlot (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/red-data-tools/YouPlot) - Command-line tool that draws plots in the terminal from piped data.

### Rust tools / Misc

*   [Charming (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/yuankunzhang/charming) - Chart rendering library for Rust powered by Apache ECharts.
*   [Plotly.rs (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.rs) - Plotly.js-based interactive plotting library for Rust.
*   [Plotters (⭐4.6k)](https://github.com/plotters-rs/plotters) - Drawing library for data plotting in Rust, with bitmap, SVG, WebAssembly and GUI backends.

### Markup-based tools / Misc

*   [C4-PlantUML (⭐7.4k)](https://github.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML) - PlantUML macros and styles for drawing software architecture diagrams with the C4 model.
*   [CeTZ (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/cetz-package/cetz) - Drawing library for Typst with a TikZ-inspired API, for diagrams and plots.
*   [D2 (⭐26k)](https://github.com/d2lang/d2) - Declarative diagram scripting language that turns text into diagrams.
*   [Diagrams (⭐43k)](https://github.com/mingrammer/diagrams) - Diagram as code in Python for prototyping cloud system architectures.
*   [Flowchart Fun (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/tone-row/flowchart-fun) - Web app that generates flowcharts and diagrams from indented text.
*   [flowchart.js (⭐8.7k)](https://github.com/adrai/flowchart.js) - Draws SVG flowcharts from a textual description.
*   [Kroki (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/yuzutech/kroki) - Unified API that renders diagrams from many text formats, including PlantUML, Mermaid, Graphviz and D2.
*   [LikeC4 (⭐5.8k)](https://github.com/likec4/likec4) - Architecture-as-code language and tools that generate live, interactive diagrams.
*   [Markmap (⭐13k)](https://github.com/markmap/markmap) - Builds interactive mind maps from Markdown.
*   [Mermaid (⭐91k)](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) - Generate diagrams and flowcharts from markdown-like text definitions, with a [live editor](https://mermaid.live).
*   [nomnoml (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/skanaar/nomnoml) - Draws UML diagrams from a simple text syntax.
*   [Penrose (⭐8k)](https://github.com/penrose/penrose) - Creates diagrams from mathematical notation in plain text, from Carnegie Mellon University.
*   [PGF/TikZ (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/pgf-tikz/pgf) - TeX packages for programmatically drawing vector graphics and diagrams in LaTeX.
*   [PGFPlots (⭐257)](https://github.com/pgf-tikz/pgfplots) - TeX package for drawing 2D and 3D plots directly in LaTeX documents.
*   [PlantUML (⭐13k)](https://github.com/plantuml/plantuml) - Generates UML, Gantt, mind map and other diagrams from plain text.
*   [Svgbob (⭐4.2k)](https://github.com/ivanceras/svgbob) - Converts ASCII art diagrams into SVG.
*   [WaveDrom](https://wavedrom.com/) - Draws timing diagrams and waveforms from simple textual descriptions.

### Other tools / Misc

*   [Cytoscape (⭐731)](https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape) - Desktop platform for network analysis and visualization, widely used in bioinformatics.
*   [Data Formulator (⭐18k)](https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator) - AI-assisted tool for transforming data and creating visualizations, from Microsoft Research.
*   [FlameGraph (⭐20k)](https://github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph) - Stack trace visualizer that generates interactive SVG flame graphs from profiling data.
*   [GeoLibre (⭐7.8k)](https://github.com/opengeos/GeoLibre) - Cloud-native GIS app for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data on the web, desktop and mobile.
*   [GMT (⭐983)](https://github.com/GenericMappingTools/gmt) - Command-line tools for processing geographic data and making publication-quality maps and plots.
*   [gnuplot](http://www.gnuplot.info/) - Command-line driven program for 2D and 3D plots, with many output formats.
*   [Gource (⭐13k)](https://github.com/acaudwell/Gource) - Animated visualization of software version control history.
*   [JSON Crack (⭐44k)](https://github.com/AykutSarac/jsoncrack.com) - Visualizes JSON, YAML, XML and CSV data as interactive graphs.
*   [LabPlot (⭐486)](https://github.com/KDE/labplot) - KDE application for interactive scientific plotting, data analysis and visualization.
*   [mcp-server-chart (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/antvis/mcp-server-chart) - MCP server from AntV that lets AI agents generate more than 25 chart types.
*   [Orange (⭐5.7k)](https://github.com/biolab/orange3) - Visual programming tool for data mining, machine learning and interactive data visualization.
*   [QGIS (⭐14k)](https://github.com/qgis/QGIS) - Desktop geographic information system for viewing, editing, analyzing and mapping geospatial data.
*   [Sampler (⭐15k)](https://github.com/sqshq/sampler) - Terminal dashboard that runs shell commands and visualizes their output, configured with YAML.
*   [SandDance (⭐7.1k)](https://github.com/microsoft/SandDance) - Visual data exploration and presentation with animated unit visualizations, from Microsoft Research.
*   [sankeydiagram.net](https://sankeydiagram.net/) - Web app for creating and sharing Sankey diagrams of flows and budgets without code.
*   [SankeyMATIC (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/nowthis/sankeymatic) - Web tool for building Sankey diagrams from a plain-text description of flows.
*   [sqliteviz (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/lana-k/sqliteviz) - Browser app that loads CSV, JSON or SQLite files, runs SQL and charts the results offline.
*   [ttyplot (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/tenox7/ttyplot) - Real-time terminal plotting utility that reads data from standard input.
*   [uMap (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/umap-project/umap) - Web app for creating maps with OpenStreetMap layers and embedding them in websites.
*   [VisiData (⭐9.3k)](https://github.com/saulpw/visidata) - Terminal spreadsheet multitool for exploring and arranging tabular data, with basic plotting.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Apache ECharts (⭐67k) - Highly customizable and interactive charts ready for big datasets.
  • billboard.js (⭐6k) - Reusable D3.js-based chart library with SVG and Canvas rendering, maintained by NAVER.
  • C3.js (⭐9.3k) - D3-based reusable chart library.
  • Cal-Heatmap (⭐3.1k) - Time-series calendar heatmaps, similar to GitHub's contribution graph, built on D3.
  • Carbon Charts (⭐1.1k) - Chart library from IBM's Carbon Design System, built on D3, with React, Angular, Vue and Svelte wrappers.
  • chart.xkcd (⭐7.9k) - Chart library that renders line, bar, pie and other charts in a hand-drawn xkcd style.
  • ChartGPU (⭐3.2k) - WebGPU charting library for large datasets, real-time streaming and multi-chart dashboards.
  • Charts.css (⭐6.6k) - CSS framework that styles HTML tables as charts.
  • DHTMLX Gantt (⭐1.9k) - Gantt chart component for project schedules, with task dependencies and drag-and-drop editing.
  • ECharts GL (⭐2.7k) - Extension for Apache ECharts that adds 3D plots, globe visualizations and WebGL-accelerated series.
  • Flot (⭐5.9k) - jQuery plotting library for line, bar and pie charts with zooming and other interactive features.
  • Frappe Charts (⭐15k) - Simple, responsive SVG charts with zero dependencies.
  • Frappe Gantt (⭐6.1k) - Simple, interactive SVG Gantt chart library.
  • G2 (⭐13k) - An interactive and responsive charting library based on the grammar of graphics, maintained by Alibaba.
  • heatmap.js (⭐6.4k) - Canvas-based library for rendering heatmaps, with plugins for Leaflet and Google Maps.
  • roughViz (⭐7.2k) - Sketchy, hand-drawn style charts for the browser, based on Rough.js.
  • TOAST UI Chart (⭐5.4k) - Complete library with support for legacy browsers.
  • Unovis (⭐2.9k) - Modular data visualization framework for React, Angular, Svelte, Vue and vanilla TypeScript, by F5.
  • uPlot (⭐11k) - Small, fast canvas-based charts for time series, lines, areas, OHLC and bars.
  • VChart (⭐1.8k) - Cross-platform charting library with animation and storytelling features, from ByteDance's VisActor.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

  • 3d-force-graph (⭐6.4k) - 3D force-directed graph component using Three.js/WebGL.
  • cosmos.gl (⭐1.3k) - GPU-accelerated force graph layout and rendering engine that runs entirely in WebGL shaders.
  • dagre (⭐5.8k) - Directed graph layout library for JavaScript.
  • elkjs (⭐2.8k) - Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) graph layout algorithms for JavaScript.
  • force-graph (⭐2.1k) - Force-directed graph component rendered on HTML5 canvas.
  • JointJS (⭐5.4k) - SVG-based JavaScript diagramming library for interactive diagrams and graph editors.
  • Viz.js (⭐4.3k) - Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly for rendering DOT graphs in the browser and Node.js.
  • Vue Flow (⭐6.9k) - Flowchart and node-based graph component for Vue 3.
  • X6 (⭐6.7k) - Diagramming library for DAGs, ER diagrams, flowcharts and other graph editors, maintained by Alibaba.
  • xyflow (⭐39k) - React Flow and Svelte Flow: libraries for building node-based editors, flow charts and interactive diagrams.

JavaScript tools / Financial charts

  • chartjs-chart-financial (⭐809) - Chart.js module that adds candlestick and OHLC chart types.
  • HQChart (⭐3.4k) - K-line and stock charts with a technical indicator scripting engine, for web pages and WeChat mini programs.
  • KLineChart (⭐4.2k) - Lightweight, highly customizable candlestick (k-line) chart with zero dependencies and mobile support.
  • Lightweight Charts (⭐17k) - Performant HTML5 canvas financial charts, from TradingView.
  • React Financial Charts (⭐1.4k) - React components for financial charts: candlesticks, technical indicators, overlays and drawing tools.
  • TradeCanvas (⭐22) - Financial charts with indicators, drawing tools and live feeds, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL.
  • Vela (⭐992) - Financial charting library with a headless core, native WebGL2 renderer and plugin SDK, from LuxAlgo.

JavaScript tools / Maps

  • Cesium (⭐16k) - WebGL 3D globes and maps.
  • COBE (⭐5.9k) - Lightweight WebGL globe library of about 5 kB, with configurable markers.
  • globe.gl (⭐3.2k) - UI component for globe data visualization using Three.js/WebGL.
  • mapcn (⭐12k) - Map components for React built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind and compatible with shadcn/ui.
  • MapLibre GL JS (⭐12k) - WebGL-based interactive vector tile maps in the browser; community fork of Mapbox GL JS.
  • maptalks.js (⭐4.5k) - Pluggable JavaScript library for integrated 2D/3D maps.
  • OpenLayers (⭐13k) - Library for interactive web maps with support for many data sources, formats and projections.
  • Potree (⭐5.6k) - WebGL point cloud viewer for large datasets such as LiDAR scans.
  • React Simple Maps (⭐3.4k) - Composable SVG map charts for React, based on d3-geo and TopoJSON.
  • react-map-gl (⭐8.5k) - React components for MapLibre GL JS and Mapbox GL JS, maintained by vis.gl.
  • TerriaJS (⭐1.4k) - Library for building web-based 2D and 3D geospatial data explorers with catalogs of map layers.

JavaScript tools / d3

  • D3.js (⭐114k) - JavaScript library for producing dynamic, data-driven visualizations with SVG, Canvas and HTML.

JavaScript tools / React

  • Ant Design Charts (⭐2.2k) - React chart library based on AntV, with statistical charts, graphs and maps.
  • echarts-for-react (⭐5k) - React wrapper for Apache ECharts.
  • MUI X Charts (⭐5.9k) - React chart components from MUI; the community package is MIT-licensed.
  • react-chartjs-2 (⭐6.9k) - React components for Chart.js.
  • react-force-graph (⭐3.3k) - React components for 2D, 3D, VR and AR force-directed graphs.
  • react-plotly.js (⭐1.1k) - React component for Plotly.js charts, maintained by Plotly.
  • Semiotic (⭐2.7k) - React data visualization library for charts, network graphs and streaming data.
  • Tremor (⭐16k) - React components for building charts and dashboards, based on Recharts and Tailwind CSS.
  • visx (⭐21k) - Low-level visualization components that combine D3 with React, by Airbnb.

JavaScript tools / React Native

  • React Native Chart Kit (⭐3.1k) - Line, bar, pie, progress and contribution graph charts for React Native.
  • react-native-charts-wrapper (⭐2.5k) - React Native wrapper for MPAndroidChart and DGCharts on Android and iOS.
  • react-native-gifted-charts (⭐1.4k) - Bar, line, area, pie, radar, bubble and candlestick charts for React Native, with animations.
  • react-native-graph (⭐2.6k) - Animated, high-performance line graphs for React Native, built with Skia.
  • react-native-maps (⭐16k) - Map view component for iOS and Android in React Native.
  • Victory Native (⭐1.2k) - High-performance charting library for React Native, built on React Native Skia.

JavaScript tools / Misc

  • asciichart (⭐2.1k) - ASCII line charts for the console in Node.js and browsers, with ports to other languages.
  • blessed-contrib (⭐16k) - Terminal dashboards with charts, maps, gauges and tables, built with Node.js and ASCII/ANSI art.
  • Flint (⭐4.3k) - Chart specification language from Microsoft that compiles to Vega-Lite, ECharts, Chart.js or Plotly.
  • Layer Cake (⭐1.8k) - Graphics framework for building reusable charts with Svelte.
  • LayerChart (⭐1.3k) - Composable Svelte chart components for cartesian, radial, hierarchical, graph and geo charts.
  • Mosaic (⭐1.4k) - Framework for linking databases such as DuckDB with interactive views to visualize large datasets.
  • ng2-charts (⭐2.4k) - Angular directives for Chart.js charts.
  • ngx-charts (⭐4.4k) - Declarative charting framework for Angular, using D3 for math and Angular for rendering.
  • Perspective (⭐11k) - Interactive analytics and visualization component for large and streaming datasets, built on WebAssembly.
  • vis-timeline (⭐2.6k) - Interactive timelines and 2D graphs with items and ranges, from the vis.js project.
  • vtk.js (⭐1.5k) - JavaScript implementation of the Visualization Toolkit (VTK) for scientific visualization on the web.
  • Vue Data UI (⭐2.5k) - Vue 3 component library of charts, gauges, tables and other data visualizations.
  • vue-chartjs (⭐5.7k) - Vue.js wrapper for Chart.js.
  • vue-echarts (⭐11k) - Vue.js component for Apache ECharts.

Android tools / Misc

  • HelloCharts (⭐7.6k) - Android chart library with line, column, pie, bubble and combo charts, plus zoom and scroll.
  • Vico (⭐3.2k) - Extensible chart library for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform.

C++ tools / Misc

  • F3D (⭐4.7k) - Cross-platform, fast, and minimalist 3D viewer with scientific visualization tools.
  • ImPlot (⭐6.2k) - Immediate-mode plotting library for Dear ImGui.
  • ImPlot3D (⭐1.3k) - Immediate-mode 3D plotting extension for Dear ImGui, inspired by ImPlot.
  • MapLibre Native (⭐2.3k) - Interactive vector tile map rendering for iOS, Android and other native platforms.
  • Mapnik (⭐4k) - Toolkit for rendering maps, widely used to render OpenStreetMap tiles.
  • Matplot++ (⭐4.9k) - C++ graphics library for data visualization with a MATLAB-like API.
  • OpenSpace (⭐1.3k) - Interactive software for visualizing the known universe, from astronomy catalogs to space missions.
  • ParaView (⭐1.7k) - Multi-platform data analysis and visualization application based on VTK.
  • PlotJuggler (⭐6.2k) - open-source Qt5 application to plot charts (based on Qwt).
  • Polyscope (⭐2.2k) - Viewer and user interface for 3D geometry processing.
  • QCustomPlot - Qt C++ widget for plotting and data visualization.
  • ROOT (⭐3.3k) - CERN framework for analyzing, storing and visualizing large scientific datasets.
  • Serial Studio (⭐7.2k) - Real-time telemetry dashboard for data from serial ports, Bluetooth LE, network sockets and other sources.
  • TTK (⭐481) - Topological data analysis and visualization.
  • VisIt (⭐532) - Visualization and analysis tool for large mesh-based scientific data, developed at LLNL.
  • Visualization Toolkit (VTK) (⭐3.2k) - open-source library for 3d Graphics, image processing and visualization.

Dashboards and BI / Misc

  • Apache Superset (⭐75k) - Data exploration and visualization platform with a no-code chart builder, SQL IDE and dashboards.
  • DataLens (⭐1.7k) - Business intelligence and data visualization system, originally developed at Yandex.
  • datart (⭐2.3k) - Data visualization platform for building reports, dashboards and data stories.
  • Evidence (⭐7k) - Business intelligence as code: build reports and dashboards with SQL and Markdown.
  • Grafana (⭐77k) - Observability and data visualization platform for metrics, logs and traces from many data sources.
  • Kibana (⭐21k) - Visualization and dashboard UI for data stored in Elasticsearch.
  • Lightdash (⭐6.2k) - BI tool that turns dbt projects into metrics, charts and dashboards.
  • Metabase (⭐50k) - Business intelligence tool for querying data and building dashboards, with embedded analytics.
  • Observable Framework (⭐3.7k) - Static site generator for data apps, dashboards and reports using JavaScript, SQL and Markdown.
  • OpenSearch Dashboards (⭐2.1k) - Visualization and dashboard UI for OpenSearch; Apache-2.0 fork of Kibana 7.10.
  • Perses (⭐2.5k) - CNCF dashboard tool and open dashboard specification for observability data such as Prometheus metrics.
  • Redash (⭐29k) - Query data sources with SQL, then visualize the results and build dashboards.
  • Rill (⭐2.9k) - BI tool for fast, metrics-first dashboards powered by OLAP engines such as DuckDB and ClickHouse.

Flutter tools / Misc

  • fl_chart (⭐7.6k) - Customizable Flutter chart library with line, bar, pie, scatter and radar charts.
  • flutter_map (⭐3k) - Vendor-free, customizable interactive map package for Flutter.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Interfaces

*   [Mobile SSH](https://mobile-ssh.github.io/) - Android and iOS (TestFlight beta) SSH client for running Gemini CLI on remote servers, with a Gemini CLI installer plugin, simultaneous terminal sessions, and tmux session management.
*   [Bellows](https://bellowsai.app) - Desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP alongside Claude and Codex, with diffs, permission prompts, team rules, a hash-linked audit trail and live session sharing. Windows, macOS and Linux.

### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [puenteo (⭐1)](https://github.com/mano7onam/puenteo) - Gemini CLI extension + MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions on one machine search each other's history and message each other live (send/wait/reply, channels, file claims). Local SQLite, no daemon.

### Commands & Extensions

*   [Supercov (⭐145)](https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov) - Coverage, security and code quality for coding agents. Gemini CLI extension that runs the project's existing tests, measures line, branch and MC/DC coverage, and hands Gemini the untested code to test next. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov`.
*   [figma-maxxing (⭐8)](https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing) - Gemini CLI extension with 8 skills for agents editing real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, and a handoff gate. Built on figma-console-mcp; 3 of the checks also ran once on Figma's official MCP server. MIT. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Awakado](https://awakado.noodledragon.studio) - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
*   [SkillKeeper](https://skillkeeper.app/) - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.
*   [fakegreen (⭐2)](https://github.com/fitzyracing1/fakegreen) - Deterministic diff checker with an `AfterAgent` hook (`npx fakegreen install gemini`) that denies the turn when the agent skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, added suppressions, special-cased the test environment or forced CI green with `|| true`, and feeds the findings back so Gemini fixes them. No LLM or API key. MIT.

### API Bridges & Proxies

*   [cliproxy-rs (⭐16)](https://github.com/vayungodara/cliproxy-rs) - Rust rewrite of CLIProxyAPI with a built-in dashboard. Serves the Gemini API on a local endpoint (`GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL`), so Gemini CLI can run on Gemini API keys or on signed-in Claude and ChatGPT accounts.

### MCP Servers

*   [Connections (⭐1)](https://github.com/Lunarwerx/connections-gemini-extension) - Work a free Connections contact book, follow-ups, ticketed event pages, notes and email from Gemini CLI; no card needed for the account. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth sign-in at `https://studio.connections.icu/v1/mcp`. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Lunarwerx/connections-gemini-extension`.
*   [LinkMCP](https://app.linkmcp.io) - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp`.
*   [MAQAMI Travel (⭐2)](https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server) - Hotel and flight search and booking from Gemini CLI: search hotels (3M+) and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then prebook and book a chosen offer after the user confirms. Remote Streamable HTTP (`https://mcp.maqami.co/`), no sign-in or API key. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server`.
